Fresh base install passed 85 non-Torch tests; full environment 100 Python tests and 5 JS tests pass. All 26 Chromium checks pass and the actual browser-downloaded TIFF passes independent Rasterio cell/NaN identity. Full original prompt preserved and requirements explicitly distinguish implemented engineering from unmet winning-score/independent-truth goals. PR/deployment follows, recorded separately after execution. Final staging review found and fixed an omitted linked test-source directory; the public allowlist now includes tests without raw data/.git. Final local reference count 192.

passes.title: Leakage, implementation, source-integrity and GeoTIFF review
passes.summary: Reviewed the label-free XEDGE transform, fixed 300/600/1,200 m scales, 48-pixel support erosion, zero-edge tie handling, spatial-fold runner and fail-closed gates. Builder has no label/template path; AST guard and tests pass. No network/leaderboard/upload path was added. Direct independent format check confirms one float32 band on the pinned 3,292×3,730 grid, EPSG:32611, exact template transform, [0,1] footprint values and NaN outside; exact TIFF SHA matches the holdout receipt. Helper-script execution hashes are explicitly marked reconstructed after provenance-guard-only edits; this is software evidence, not hardware attestation.

passes.title: Submission-guide, first-screen, download and browser/site review
passes.summary: Verified root and nested download links point to the unique XEDGE OOF research file and prominent warning, guide explains the exact artifact, unique name/comment, checksum and [0,1]/grid checks, and no wording implies approval or a new score. Responsive Chromium review passed desktop, laptop, mobile and small-mobile; exact bytes/hash and direct-click filename pass; note copy, interactive SHA, historical map, guide/research/source/review pages pass; no JavaScript errors or external automatic requests. Source and staged sites each pass local-reference verification. This is local site QA, not proof of remote deployment or organizer acceptance.
